experience.blurb: Option Circle — options-trading automation. My work spans the LLM conversion layer, trailing-stop engine, and tiered profit-taking.

roles.title: Trading Execution & Exits
roles.blurb: Building the execution paths that turn a trader's exit rules into broker orders, with state coordination across market ticks, working orders, and fills.

contributions.text: Shipped configurable profit-taking across TradeStation, TastyTrade, Tradier and Webull, plus paper trading. Positions can close in steps as profit targets are reached.

Sized each tier from original holdings, preserved multi-leg spread ratios, and capped orders at holdings minus working quantities to prevent overselling. The final tier closes all remaining contracts.
Coordinated fills, partial fills, cancellations and retries with Redis order-to-tier state. Duplicate-message guards and atomic fill claims prevent repeated processing and duplicate sell records.
Built a Redis Lua engine for profit and loss trailing, with atomic per-tick peak tracking and exit evaluation. Rules arrive through Redis Streams; close requests reach Bot-Engine over Kafka.
Added shared close locks, broker-stage lock extension and trigger-time checks to suppress duplicate exit requests while allowing failed closes to retry.

roles.title: Natural Language → Trading Bots
roles.blurb: Built the production LLM parser and conversion layer: a trader describes a strategy, and the service turns it into a validated bot that can be saved and scheduled.

contributions.text: Used Gemini, Java, Spring Boot and embedded LuaJ to convert natural-language instructions into workflow nodes and edges across 24 trading strategies, then persisted and scheduled bots through Bot-Engine.
Checked required fields and allowed values on the server before conversion. Build-time checks against UI and engine definitions catch configuration drift before deployment.
Passed the structured specification through Java validation and Lua conversion, then assembled the workflow graph consumed by the trading engine.
Integrated Gemini through non-blocking Spring WebFlux clients. One model request produces both the structured bot specification and its explanation.

projects.name: TickPulse
projects.summary: Market alert and trailing-stop engine. Live crypto ticks from the Binance WebSocket land in Redis Streams, get evaluated atomically by Lua, and fan out to clients over Server-Sent Events.
projects.impact: Redis Streams ingestion and Lua rule evaluation, Server-Sent Events for live alerts, and PostgreSQL alert history. Docker supports the local stack; Testcontainers integration tests verify Redis state transitions.

projects.summary: Java/Spring Boot service combining GitHub, Reddit and Spotify data with Gemini-generated responses.
projects.impact: Implemented Spotify OAuth 2.0 token exchange, third-party API error handling and JSON parsing to bring profile data and LLM responses behind one backend service.
